_comment: Plots the homebuyer bots trade in USDC property offers (agents/plot-market.js). Each market names its city, the lens member that states who first holds each plot (from its devnet owner registry, consensus.lens_devnet_owner, basis registry) and confirms sales, and the plots as their parcel source gives them: id, an interior point (at) and a label. Who holds a plot is the registry's and then the lens member's word, never this file's; homebuyers are registered as owners with scripts/seed-lens-owners.mjs --parcel ID --persona NAME.
